manifest.selection: equal mean over two datasets and four domains of tune nDCG@10; quality=best reranked; balanced=best reranked with k<=30 and tokens=512; ties prefer shorter inputs, fewer candidates, then name
manifest.rewrite: frozen existing cache; zero API calls
manifest.limitations: Previously evaluated data; internal validation, not unseen blind test. Only reranker length is tuned; embedding stays at 512 tokens.
